Device profile 'Windows | ? | edge 16.0 | ?' was not used by this card before; identity record marks it New.

Measured on October: all 1,203 disputes the bank investigated were fraud, 15% of them scored under 0.05, so a low score does not clear a denial (1.00). If this is a planted dispute on a legitimate transaction, a score this size is 24.16x as likely on disputed fraud as on a legitimate transaction (0.96). Weighted equally: 0.98.
Card-not-present fraud from a new device: as above, with the identity record marking the device New for this account, sometimes behind a proxy.
